name: TextWarden (Grammarly Replacement)
description: Grammar checker that underlines mistakes as you type in Mail, TextEdit, and other apps

buttons.label: Rebuild & restart TextWarden
buttons.explain: Use this after Claude changes TextWarden's code
command: xcodebuild -project TextWarden.xcodeproj -scheme TextWarden -configuration Debug -allowProvisioningUpdates build && pkill -x TextWarden; sleep 1; open "$(ls -d ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/TextWarden-*/Build/Products/Debug/TextWarden.app | head -1)"

buttons.label: Restart TextWarden
buttons.explain: If underlines stop appearing, try this first

buttons.label: Start grammar server
buttons.explain: TextWarden uses simpler built-in checking while this is off

buttons.label: Restart grammar server
buttons.explain: Try this if suggestions seem worse than usual (TextWarden may be on its backup checker)

buttons.label: Run TextWarden tests
buttons.explain: Checks that the code still works after changes
